SHIFT TIMINGS - 12 PM - 9 PM

OFFICE LOCATION - GURUGRAM



Position Overview

As a Full Stack Developer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using React on the frontend and Java (Spring Boot) on the back-end. You will collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, and other developers to deliver high-quality, performant, and user-friendly software.

• Solid experience in Java with frameworks like Spring Boot or Jakarta EE.

• Proficient in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and RESTful API development.

• Strong understanding of database technologies (MySQL, MongoDB).

• Experience with version control systems (Git).

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

jobDescription:
Job Title: Data Engineer Azure Data Engineering & Databricks

Experience: 4–7 Years


Role Summary:

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer with solid experience in the Azure data ecosystem and hands-on expertise in Azure Databricks. The ideal candidate will have worked on designing and developing scalable, cloud-native data pipelines and solutions using Azure data services. You will contribute to building and optimizing data lakehouse and warehouse architectures, enabling efficient data ingestion, transformation, and analytics in a collaborative team environment.


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and workflows using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS).
  • Implement ETL/ELT processes using Azure Data Factory and Databricks to enable efficient data ingestion and transformation.
  • Work on building data solutions leveraging Delta Lake and implement best practices such as the Medallion Architecture.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business teams to understand data requirements and deliver effective Azure-based data solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and documentation to ensure high-quality data engineering deliverables.
  • Follow data governance, security, and compliance standards while handling data pipelines and sensitive information.
  • Implement and manage secure authentication and authorization using Azure Active Directory (AAD) and Azure Key Vault for secrets management.
  • Support CI/CD automation and monitoring of data pipelines using Azure DevOps.
  • Stay current with Azure data platform developments and contribute ideas to improve existing data infrastructure and processes.

Must-Have Skills:

  • 4+ years of experience in data engineering with a strong focus on Azure data services.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, and implementing Medallion Architecture is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency with Azure Data Factory for building ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Synapse Analytics and Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS).
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL (T-SQL). PowerShell experience is a plus.
  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) for authentication and role-based access control.
  • Familiarity with Azure Key Vault for secrets and certificate management.
  • Understanding of modern data lakehouse architectures and cloud-native data platform principles on Azure.
  • Basic knowledge of CI/CD and DevOps processes, preferably using Azure DevOps.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams.

Good-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with Delta Live Tables, MLflow, or Unity Catalog on Azure Databricks.
  • Familiarity with Azure Event Hubs, Azure Stream Analytics, or other streaming data services.
  • Awareness of Azure Purview or other data governance tools.
  • Basic exposure to Snowflake in an Azure environment, including data modeling and performance tuning.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like ARM templates or Terraform on Azure.
  • Understanding of machine learning workflows and MLOps integration within Azure.

tagsAndSkills: Data Flow,Google Workspace Admin,Google Cloud Platforms,Google Cloud Platform Administration,Python,Cloud Sql,Cloud Storage,Pubsub
jobDescription:
Overview of 66degrees

66degrees is a leading consulting and professional services company specializing in developing Al-focused, data-led solutions leveraging the latest advancements in cloud technology. With our unmatched engineering capabilities and vast industry experience, we help the world's leading brands transform their business challenges into opportunities and shape the future of work. At 66degrees, we believe in embracing the challenge and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Google Cloud and Workspace Engineer/Administrator to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for the comprehensive management and administration of all Google products, projects, sandboxes, and related infrastructure within the Google Cloud Platform (GCP), alongside the administration of Google Workspace. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the stability, security, and optimal performance of our cloud and collaboration environments.


Key Responsibilities:

Google Cloud Platform Administration:

  • Manage and administer Google Cloud projects, including creation, configuration, and resource allocation.
  • Oversee the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of various Google Cloud services (e.g., Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Kubernetes Engine).
  • Implement and enforce security best practices within GCP, including IAM, network security, and data encryption.
  • Monitor cloud resource usage, identify cost optimization opportunities, and implement efficiency improvements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve cloud infrastructure issues in a timely manner.

Google Workspace Administration:

  • Administer and support Google Workspace services, including Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Meet, and Chat.
  • Manage user accounts, groups, organizational units, and access permissions within Google Workspace.
  • Implement and enforce security and compliance policies for Google Workspace.
  • Provide technical support and guidance to users on Google Workspace features and best practices.
  • Monitor Google Workspace usage and identify opportunities for optimization.

Cloud adoption strategy:

  • The ability to align the SLZ deployment with the larger Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and a clear business case for moving workloads to a sovereign cloud environment.
  • Manage the overall setup and configuration of SLZ

Product and Sandbox Management:

  • Administer and support various Google products and applications integrated with GCP and Google Workspace.
  • Manage and maintain sandbox environments for development, testing, and experimentation.
  • Ensure proper access control and resource allocation for sandbox users.

Automation and Scripting:

  • Develop and implement automation scripts (e.g., Python, Bash, Terraform) for routine cloud and Workspace operations and infrastructure provisioning.
  • Utilize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles to manage and deploy cloud resources.

Monitoring and Alerting:

  • Set up and manage monitoring tools and dashboards for cloud infrastructure and applications, as well as Google Workspace.
  • Configure alerts and notifications for critical events and performance thresholds.

Network Segmentation:

  • Implement strong network segmentation using VPCs, subnets, and firewall rules to isolate different environments (e.g., production, development, staging) and workloads within the SLZ.

Identity and Access Management (IAM):

  • Establish a robust IAM strategy with granular permissions, principle of least privilege, and multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all access to the SLZ, leveraging Google Cloud IAM roles and custom roles as needed.

Logging and Monitoring:

  • Configure comprehensive logging and monitoring capabilities using Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring to capture all activities, security events, and resource utilization within the SLZ, enabling proactive threat detection and compliance auditing.

Security Services Integration:

  • Integrate native Google Cloud security services such as Security Command Center, Cloud Armor, and Cloud IDS/IPS to enhance threat protection, vulnerability management, and real-time anomaly detection within the SLZ.

Documentation:

  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for cloud and Workspace architecture, configurations, and operational procedures.

Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with development, operations, and security teams to ensure seamless integration and support of cloud and collaboration solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to internal teams on GCP and Google Workspace best practices.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven experience as a Google Cloud Engineer/Administrator or similar role.
  • Proven experience in administering Google Workspace.
  • Proven experience in establishing, maintaining, and managing Google Cloud billing accounts,cloud spends and overall financials ensuring strict adherence to financial policies and regulatory requirements.
  • In-depth knowledge of Google Cloud Platform services and architecture.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts (VPC, VPN, Load Balancing) in a cloud environment.
  • Experience with identity and access management (IAM) in GCP and user management in Google Workspace.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash)
  • Proficiency in executing the core Terraform workflow
  • Expertise in managing Terraform state, including local and remote backends, state locking, and handling sensitive data.
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps principles.
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud certification (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud Engineer).
  • Google Workspace certification (e.g., Google Workspace Administrator).
  • Experience with hybrid cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of database administration on GCP (e.g., Cloud SQL, Cloud Spanner).
  • Experience with big data technologies on GCP (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow).

66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.

Job Description: QA Manual Tester

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute detailed test plans manually on the product to ensure compliance with specifications and

requirements.

  • Update the steps and expected results in the test plans as needed as the product evolves
  • Perform regression testing to ensure the stability of software releases.
  • Identify, document, and report defects accurately using designated defect tracking tool (Jira).
  • Verify fixes for defects.
  • Communicate test results and progress updates to the Director of Quality Assurance and relevant

stakeholders.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Participate in requirements review and review sessions to gain a thorough understanding of project

objectives and new features.

  • Contribute suggestions to improve functional test coverage of test plans and documentation.
  • Conduct exploratory testing to uncover hidden defects and usability issues.
  • Provide feedback on product usability and suggest improvements on the user experience using the

appropriate feedback channels.

Requirements

  • Experience in manual software testing practices, preferably in a QA role.
  • Previous experience in testing browser-based applications.
  • Strong attention to detail and thoroughness in test execution and defect reporting.
  • Ability to isolate sources of defects and generalize the scope of the issues.
  • Familiarity with defect tracking systems and test management tools.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing project requirements and priorities.

  • Previous involvement in cross-functional collaboration with QA teams, UX designers, developers, and

product managers to align testing efforts with product goals and user needs.

  • Background in finance or insurance industries.
  • Experience with Slack and Jira
  • Python scripting and familiarity with JSON files preferred.

About You

You are patient, friendly, and thrive on working in a startup environment with an extremely talented crew of

like-minded people. You are detail-oriented and can be counted on to deliver high quality results on time. You are

familiar with browser-based applications, and are technically experienced enough to isolate the cause of issues

and provide detailed defect reports when things break. You are also a proactive communicator and love to ask

questions and receive feedback.


IMMEDIATE JOINERS ONLY

Dentira (One of Uplers' Clients) is Looking for:

Software Development Engineer in Test - II who is passionate about their work, eager to learn and grow, and who is committed to delivering exceptional results. If you are a team player, with a positive attitude and a desire to make a difference, then we want to hear from you.

Role Overview Description

Dentira is on the lookout for a kickass Senior SDET to spearhead and implement our test automation strategy. We are looking for someone who is not just experienced but also enthusiastic about discovering software issues and driving innovation in our testing processes. If you excel in ensuring the highest standards of product reliability and performance through automation, we would love to have you on our team. In this pivotal role, you will be at the forefront of ensuring Dentira's products meet the highest standards of quality. Your expertise will be crucial in developing and implementing robust, scalable, and comprehensive automated testing suites. We value self-driven professionals who can work independently and thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment. You'll need to manage multiple priorities effectively while demonstrating strong initiative and leadership in your role.

Responsibilities

  • Begin by conducting thorough manual testing to understand the products nuances and identify areas for automation. Deep dive into manual testing to gain insights necessary for creating effective automated tests.
  • Transition manual tests into automated suites, ensuring they are efficient and cover critical functionalities and scenarios.
  • Define and execute a robust test automation strategy that aligns with our business goals and product development roadmap.
  • Architect, develop, and maintain a comprehensive suite of automated tests covering functional, non-functional, regression, and smoke testing.
  • Continuously improve the automation framework and testing processes to enhance efficiency and coverage.
  • Challenge the status quo by questioning existing processes and suggesting innovative improvements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends, tools, and technologies to keep our testing practices on the cutting edge.
  • Roll up your sleeves to tackle challenging problems and lead by example, demonstrating strong technical leadership and problem-solving capabilities.

Primary Requirements

  • 3+ years of extensive experience in creation and implementation of automation frameworks for Web (including complex SPAs) and APIs.
  • Adept in designing effective test cases and creating relevant test data to validate various functionalities and scenarios. Capable of anticipating edge cases and ensuring thorough coverage.
  • Proficient with modern JavaScript-based automation tools and frameworks such as Playwright, Jest (experience with Selenium, Cypress, REST Assured etc is also acceptable).
  • Good grasp of Javascript
  • Prior experience in any test management tool like JIRA
  • Proficient in using Postman for API testing, including creating and running automated
  • Ability to design and execute tests at various levels, including unit, integration, system, acceptance, and performance testing.

Good to have

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases (MongoDB preferred)
  • Knowledge of Apache Jmeter (or other tools) for Performance testing
  • Typescript exposure
  • Familiar with Linux based OS
  • Experience in testing of mobile applications
  • Experience of working in product companies or fast-growing startups

How to apply for this opportunity:

Easy 3-Step Process:
1. Click On Apply! And Register or log in on our portal

2. Upload updated Resume & Complete the Screening Form

3. Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!


About Our Client:

Vertically integrated procurement platform for Healthcare with Top VC as lead investor, growing 100% QoQ and already revenue positive.


About Uplers:

Our goal is to make hiring and getting hired reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant product and engineering job opportunities and progress in their career.


(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal.)


So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

  • Prior experience in any test management tool like JIRA

  • Ability to design and execute tests at various levels, including unit, integration, system, acceptance, and performance testing.

Good to have

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases (MongoDB preferred)
  • Knowledge of Apache Jmeter (or other tools) for Performance testing
  • Typescript exposure
  • Familiar with Linux based OS
  • Experience in testing of mobile applications
  • Experience of working in product companies or fast-growing startups

Its not everyday that you consider starting a new career challenge.

Were RingCentral, a global leader in cloud-based communications and collaboration software. We are fundamentally changing the nature of human interaction—giving people the freedom to connect powerfully and personally from anywhere, at any time, on any device.

We’re a $2 billion company that’s growing at 30+% annually and we’re expanding our Solutions Engineering Team to make sure we stay ahead of the competition.


We’re currently looking for: Staff Engineer, Bengaluru

The stack used is: React, TypeScript, Redux, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Testing-Library.


To succeed in this role you must have experience in the following:

  • Minimum 7+ years of experience as UI Engineer or UI Architect
  • Should still be coding hands-on, i..e lead by example
  • Successful track record of leading architectural design and implementation of at least one flagship app with significant user-base, that involved multiple platforms and teams.
  • Proven record of building high performance and high-reliability client-side (rather than backend) applications and driving architecture evolution
  • Experience in collaborating with backend teams on technical solutions and API design
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and solve the complex problems with global view in mind, and make balanced decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to successfully present the architectural decisions to executives and stakeholders
  • Advanced understanding of current design patterns and paradigm.
  • Strong business sense and insights of product features
  • 5+ years of working experience in React.js ecosystem libraries like redux or MobX or material-ui.
  • Know-how with regard to front-end tooling such as Webpack, Babel, ESlint, etc.
  • Familiarity with the bundling process and how to configure webpack/rollup from scratch
  • Understanding how to use browser development tools and how to use them in JavaScript code
  • Willingness to take ownership of the tasks and to achieve targets with minimum supervision
  • Experience with SaaS, distributed, highly available, event-driven systems
  • Ability to analyze, troubleshoot, and solve a wide range of technical problems. Strong problem-solving skills, a can-do attitude
  • Have a good knowledge of UX designing
  • Nice to have experience working with WebRTC

  • Provide application client-side architectural vision and drive evolution and roadmap
  • Create architectural solutions that maximize the sharable components and enables independent development, test, release and deployment of multiple front-end sub-apps residing in the shell application.

  • Make app architectural decisions and communicate to executives and stakeholders
  • Define architecture policies and establish governance mechanism, and supervise architectural implementation

  • Review the key architecture designs proposed by application teams
  • Support the product management team on technical evaluation and input
  • Locate and direct solutions for technical challenges or customer issues
  • Drive the application technology evolution by introducing the new technology to the team and product implementation.

Must have skills required :

React.js OR HTML OR CSS OR TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js OR Express.js


Lucio (One of Uplers' Clients) is Looking for:

Sr. Frontend Engineer who is passionate about their work, eager to learn and grow, and who is committed to delivering exceptional results. If you are a team player, with a positive attitude and a desire to make a difference, then we want to hear from you.


Role Overview Description

About Lucio:
We're an AI product company that wants to transform the legal industry using generative AI. We're a rapidly growing team with a truly innovative product that is already being used at many top law firms in the country. We're building a team of talented developers who are passionate about building products that solve real-world problems.


We're looking to hire a talented Frontend Engineer who is passionate about building beautiful interfaces and new user experiences.


You will excel at this role if you:

  • Have an eye for detail
  • Love creating and thinking of new user flows and experiences
  • Want to help build delightful products

Must-Have Skills (Essential):

  • Strong Proficiency in Core Web Technologies:
  • JavaScript (ES6+): Deep understanding of core JavaScript concepts, asynchronous programming (Promises, async/await), and modern language features.
  • CSS3: Excellent understanding of CSS fundamentals, layout techniques (Flexbox, Grid), responsive design principles, and CSS preprocessors (like Sass or Less, though Tailwind is a separate "Good to Have").
  • React: Solid experience building complex user interfaces with React, including component lifecycle, hooks, state management (even if not a preferred library initially), and routing.
  • UI Design Systems/Component Libraries: Demonstrated experience working with at least one major UI Design System/Component Library. MUI (Preferred) is a significant plus. Familiarity with AntD, Chakra UI, or Mantine is also valuable.
  • State Management: Practical experience with at least one client-side state management library. Redux Toolkit or Zustand (Preferred) indicates a good understanding of managing application state effectively.
  • Server-Side State Management/Data Fetching: Experience with a server-side state management/data fetching library like SWR, React Query (Tanstack Query) (Preferred), or RTK Query is highly desirable, showcasing knowledge of efficient data handling.
  • Form Handling and Validation:
  • Experience with form handling in React and implementing robust validation.
  • Familiarity with react-hook-form (preferred) for form management.
  • Knowledge of zod (preferred) or yup for schema definition and validation.
  • Performance Optimization: Proven ability to identify and implement performance optimizations in frontend applications. This includes techniques like code splitting, lazy loading, memoization, efficient rendering, and optimizing API calls.
  • Good Code Practices: Strong understanding of clean code principles, writing maintainable and scalable code, following coding standards, and using linting and formatting tools (e.g., ESLint, Prettier).
  • Version Control (Git): Proficient in using Git for version control, branching strategies, and collaborating with a team.
  • Understanding of Web Development Fundamentals: Knowledge of HTTP protocols, RESTful APIs, and browser developer tools.

Good to Have Skills (Beneficial):

  • Next.js or React Router (Remix): Production experience with these frameworks is a significant plus, indicating familiarity with server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and their respective feature sets.
  • Tailwind CSS: Experience with utility-first CSS frameworks like Tailwind CSS can be beneficial for rapid styling and consistency.
  • Node.js and Express.js: Basic understanding or prior experience with Node.js and Express.js for backend development can be a valuable asset for understanding the full-stack picture and potentially contributing to API integrations or basic backend tasks.
  • Build Tools: Familiarity with build tools like Webpack, Parcel, or Vite.
  • Accessibility (A11y): Awareness of and ability to implement accessible web applications (following WCAG guidelines).

We're looking for candidates with 5 to 8 years experience, either through great independent projects or working with companies. You don't necessarily need a degree in CS as long as you have the right skillset.


Pay and Benefits:

We're happy to offer up to 45 LPA based on experience and skills. We offer great benefits like:

  • unlimited leaves (including sick leaves, period leaves, and more)
  • great flexibility around work timings,
  • an inclusive and diverse working environment.

title: SharePoint Developer & Administrator (Intranet Solutions)
jobDescription:
About the Role

We are looking for a SharePoint Developer & Administrator to take complete ownership of our organizations SharePoint Online environment and build a modern, intelligent intranet that drives communication, collaboration, and productivity.

You will both design and develop the intranet using Microsoft's best practices and manage ongoing administration, access control, and platform governance. You will work closely with business stakeholders, IT, and leadership to ensure the intranet stays secure, user-friendly, and aligned with organizational goals.


Key Responsibilities

Intranet Design & Development

  • Plan and architect the intranet structure (hub sites, communication sites, home site, navigation, taxonomy).
  • Build modern pages, web parts, and site templates using SharePoint Framework (SPFx), REST API, Microsoft Graph, and PnP libraries.
  • Automate site provisioning, permissions, and content deployment.
  • Integrate SharePoint with Microsoft Teams, Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate), and third-party tools.
  • Configure and optimize search (managed metadata, refiners, promoted results).
  • Migrate existing content from legacy intranet or file shares to SharePoint Online.

Administration & Maintenance

  • Perform day-to-day SharePoint Online administration:
  • Site creation, structure updates, and content management.
  • User and group access provisioning, permissions management.
  • Monitoring usage, storage quotas, and system health.
  • Applying updates, patches, and deploying custom solutions.
  • Maintain governance policies, retention settings, and security compliance.
  • Troubleshoot user issues, resolve incidents, and act as the first line of SharePoint support.
  • Implement and test backup, restore, and disaster recovery plans.
  • Governance, Training & Adoption
  • Define and enforce intranet governance: site naming conventions, approval workflows, lifecycle management.
  • Train site owners and content creators; prepare user guides and help documentation.
  • Track adoption and usage analytics, gather feedback, and continuously improve the intranet experience.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience in SharePoint Online administration & development (minimum 4+ years).
  • Strong skills in SPFx, React/TypeScript, REST API, Microsoft Graph, PnP PowerShell.
  • Experience configuring search, metadata, content types, site designs/templates.
  • Knowledge of Azure AD, conditional access, and Microsoft 365 security/compliance features.
  • Familiarity with Power Automate, Power Apps, and Teams integration.
  • Hands-on experience with backup, restore, and troubleshooting SharePoint issues.

Governance & Process

  • Experience defining governance frameworks, provisioning processes, and retention policies.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into well-structured intranet solutions.

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Proactive problem solver and platform owner mindset.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Microsoft certifications (MS-600, MS-700, or equivalent).
  • Experience with Viva Connections / Viva Engage.
  • Knowledge of Azure Functions or Logic Apps for automation.
  • Familiarity with accessibility (WCAG) and responsive design best practices.

Why Join Us

  • Take end-to-end ownership of a modern intranet platform.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge Microsoft 365 technologies.
  • Collaborative culture with support for innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Flexible working environment (remote / hybrid options).

We are looking for a hands-on Machine Learning Advisor who can both build initial models and mentor our junior engineers as they refine and productionize them. This is a part-time role designed for a senior professional who enjoys rolling up their sleeves to prototype and code, while also providing strategic guidance, architecture oversight, and mentorship.You will help us establish a solid ML foundation by:

  • Building and validating the first versions of our models.
  • Setting up the right processes, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Working closely with junior team members to fine-tune, scale, and optimize models.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a builder + advisor hybrid capacity, balancing hands-on contributions with leadership and mentorship.

  • Hands-On Model Development
    • Design and build the initial versions of ML models (regression, classification, clustering, or deep learning, depending on problem type).
    • Perform feature engineering, experimentation, and hyperparameter tuning.
    • Develop clean, scalable code for model training and inference.

  • Mentorship & Refinement
    • Work with junior ML engineers to iterate, refine, and fine-tune models.
    • Review their code, guide debugging, and introduce advanced techniques.
    • Transfer knowledge and upskill the team for long-term ownership.

  • Architecture & Best Practices
    • Define the ML project workflow (from data prep to deployment).
    • Set up reproducibility, versioning, and experiment tracking.
    • Recommend scalable approaches for data pipelines and model serving.

  • Collaboration
    • Partner with product and engineering to align ML solutions with business needs.
    • Communicate model performance, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • 8 to 10+ years of professional experience in machine learning, including building and deploying models.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn) and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras).
  • Experience designing end-to-end ML workflows, from feature extraction to deployment.
  • Solid knowledge of ML algorithms, evaluation metrics, and optimization techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and big data tools (Spark, PySpark).

  • Strong track record of mentorship and technical leadership.

  • Exposure to deploying ML models as APIs (FastAPI, Flask).
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications.

What We Offer

  • A part-time, flexible role with high impact (20 hours/week).

jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Quality Control Engineer with a

background in Chemical Engineering and specific expertise in concrete admixtures. The

materials, and finished admixture products meet the established quality standards and

specifications. This role is critical in maintaining our reputation for excellence and reliability in

incoming raw materials and outgoing finished admixture products to ensure they

meet the company's quality parameters and relevant industry standards (e.g., IS,

ASTM).

manufacturing process, implementing corrective actions as necessary to address any

deviations from the standard.

• Product Performance Analysis: Perform various tests on admixture products,

including but not limited to, setting time, compressive strength, and workability of

concrete.

• Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate and detailed records of all quality

control tests and analyses. Prepare certificates of analysis (COA) for finished

products and generate regular quality reports for management.

• Non-Conformance Management: Identify and document any non-conforming

materials or products. Work with the production team to investigate the root cause

and implement corrective and preventive actions.

• Calibration and Maintenance: Ensure that all laboratory equipment is properly

calibrated, maintained, and in good working order.

• Customer Complaint Resolution: Assist in the investigation and resolution of

customer complaints related to product quality, providing technical support and

analysis as required.

• Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE): Adhere to all company safety procedures

and guidelines within the laboratory and plant to ensure a safe working environment.

• Continuous Improvement: Participate in and contribute to continuous improvement

initiatives to enhance quality control processes, test methods, and product quality.

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering is mandatory.


• Experience: A minimum of 3-5 years of hands-on experience in a quality control role

within the construction chemical industry, with a specific focus on concrete

admixtures.

admixtures.

the construction chemical industry.

materials.

incident resolution; coordinate directly with Zoho support/engineering.

materials for client admins and internal teams.

brownbag sessions on advanced Zoho features.

  • Contribute to presales efforts: levelofeffort estimation, technical proposals, and

proofofconcept demonstrations.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years leading enterprise

SaaS/CRM implementations.

  • Proven track record designing and deploying multimodule Zoho solutions (minimum 3

largescale rollouts of Zoho CRM plus two or more additional Zoho apps).

  • Expertlevel proficiency in Deluge scripting, Zoho REST APIs, and integration patterns

(OAuth 2.0, JWT, SAML, webhooks).

  • Handson experience with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQL Server) and

datamigration tooling.

  • Strong understanding of DevOps fundamentals: Git, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines,

containerization.

  • Excellent clientfacing communication and stakeholdermanagement skills.
  • Ability to lead technical teams and manage multiple concurrent projects.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or MBA with technology focus.
  • Zoho Certified Developer / Administrator credentials.
  • Experience integrating Zoho with ERP suites (SAP, Oracle), cloud data warehouses, or

AI/ML platforms.

  • Familiarity with BFSI or highly regulated industries (PCIDSS, ISO 27001, IRDAI

guidelines).

  • Knowledge of RPA tools (UiPath, Automation Anywhere) and lowcode platforms.

  • Zoho CRM: Advanced customization, Canvas & Wizards, Blueprints, scoring rules, Zia

AI configuration.

  • Zoho Creator: Complex multipage apps, Deluge workflows, mobilefirst design,

granular permissions.

  • Zoho One Suite: Crossmodule automation, single signon, centralized admin console,

unified analytics.

  • Zoho Analytics: Data modeling, custom dashboards, KPI tracking, embedded BI for

executive reporting.

  • Deluge & API Mastery: Custom functions, serverside integrations, webhook

orchestration, bulk API optimizations.

  • Analyse/troubleshoot and provide 3rd line support on infrastructure issues

  • Support and troubleshoot server hardware, virtualization, and enterprise storage systems.
  • Maintain and improve Active Directory, Entra ID, Group Policy, and Intune device management.
  • Oversee system performance, patching, monitoring, and security updates.
  • Manage and monitor backup and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Manage and troubleshoot networking equipment, including Cisco, Meraki, Aruba, Unifi, and WatchGuard.
  • Monitor and maintain LAN, WAN, VPN, and wireless network infrastructure.
  • Configure and manage DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and routing.
  • Support security best practices, including firewall administration, endpoint protection, and compliance.
  • Administer and support Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive).
  • Manage Microsoft Intune for device compliance, mobile management, and application deployment.
  • Support and optimize Azure services, including Entra ID, virtual machines, and hybrid integrations.
  • Troubleshoot hybrid cloud environments and ensure seamless connectivity.
  • Act as an escalation point for 1st/2nd line engineers.
  • Liaise with vendors and partners to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation for systems, configurations, and incident resolution.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and the Cyber Security function on security and compliance initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 10+ years proven experience in a senior server and infrastructure or 3rd line IT support role.
  • Strong background in VMware administration and troubleshooting.
  • Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 administration expertise.
  • Hands-on with Intune and modern device management.
  • Strong understanding of Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and VLANs.
  • Networking knowledge with Cisco, Meraki, Aruba, Unifi, and WatchGuard firewalls, routers, and switches.
  • Security-focused, with patch management, endpoint security, and firewall skills.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with conversational/good English.
  • Flexibility to work in the UK/EU time zone.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft and other certifications pertinent to the role.
  • Degree-level education.

Benefits:

  • Two salary reviews in the first year.
  • Annual loyalty bonus.
  • 25 days paid annual leave.

title: Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Role Overview

As a Junior Data Scientist in the Data & AI Delivery team, you will work closely with senior data scientists and delivery leads to design, develop, and deploy AI/ML solutions that address real-world business problems. This role is ideal for candidates who are passionate about data science, eager to learn cutting-edge AI technologies, and ready to grow into a future technical leader.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Development & Implementation

  • Assist in building end-to-end data science workflows including data ingestion, preprocessing, modeling, and deployment.
  • Assist in deploying models into applications via APIs for real-world use cases
  • Develop, test, and validate machine learning models under guidance from senior team members.
  • Support integration of AI/ML models into business applications and existing platforms.

Data Manipulation & Analysis

  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA), feature engineering, and data cleaning using Python, SQL
  • Work with big data processing frameworks such as Spark/Hadoop in real project settings.

Generative AI & Advanced ML (Exposure & Learning)

  • Gain exposure to Generative AI (e.g., GPT, Hugging Face Transformers) and contribute to fine-tuning and experimentation tasks.
  • Participate in pilots involving GenAI for text generation, conversational AI, and content automation.

MLOps & Deployment Support

  • Learn and assist in deploying ML models using MLOps pipelines and tools (MLflow, TFX, Kubeflow).
  • Help monitor model performance, track metrics, and troubleshoot issues in production.
  • Possess hands-on exposure to Kubernetes for orchestrating and managing AI workloads.

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Work alongside senior data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements.
  • Document workflows, experiments, and project outcomes for knowledge sharing and reusability.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong programming foundation in Python (R/Scala is a plus).
  • Good understanding of machine learning concepts and libraries (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and data wrangling.
  • Familiarity with APIs (REST/GraphQL) for integrating ML models.
  • Basic understanding or exposure to Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) in projects/internships.
  • Curiosity and eagerness to learn advanced areas such as MLOps, Big Data, and Generative AI.

Preferred Background

  • Bachelors/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or related field.
  • Strong experience in building genAI applications
  • Internship, project work, or Kaggle/competition experience in ML/AI.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a collaborative mindset.

What We Offer

  • Mentorship from senior Data & AI leaders.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, Kubernetes, and cloud-native AI deployments.
  • Exposure to enterprise-grade ML/AI and Generative AI solutions.
  • Platforms to contribute to thought leadership through knowledge sharing, innovation showcases, and community engagement.
  • A clear learning path towards Data Scientist / MLOps Engineer / AI Specialist roles.Role & responsibilities

Solution Design & Architecture

Integration & Data Strategy

  • Review code and configurations for adherence to design principles.
  • Support DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines and release management.

Documentation & Enablement

  • Document solution designs, technical specifications, and system configurations.
  • Mentor junior architects and developers.
  • Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and support user training.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Salesforce architecture and solution design.
  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities, including Apex, LWC, Visualforce, and Flow.
  • Proficiency with Web Services frameworks/protocols (SOAP, XML, JSON, REST).
  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect and System Architect.
  • Experience with multi-cloud implementations and enterprise-scale projects.

  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

title: Technical Lead, UI Development
jobDescription:
Job Title: Technical Lead, UI Development
Location: Pune, India
Job Type: Full-Time

About Assent
Assent is the global leader in supply chain sustainability management, empowering manufacturers to navigate complex regulations and drive responsible business practices. Our comprehensive solutions span Product Compliance, ESG, and Trade Compliance, combining powerful cloud-based software with expert services to help companies map, monitor, and manage their suppliers, products, and materials.
In early 2024, we hit a huge milestone: $100M in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)! This makes us the first Certified B Corporation in North Americas SaaS sustainability industry to reach this level. Whats a B Corporation, you ask? It means were committed to balancing purpose and profitdoing well by doing good.
From US5M to US100M ARR in just eight years, were growing fastand were just getting started. Join us as we continue to make a global impact and build a more sustainable future.
As a Technical Lead, UI Development at Assent, youll be part of something bigger. Whether youre [insert key responsibility, e.g., building innovative software, solving complex sustainability puzzles, or supporting global customers], your work will directly contribute to our mission. Youll collaborate with talented teams across the globe, learn from the best, and grow both personally and professionally.
Heres What Youll Do
Were looking for a Technical UI Lead with deep expertise in Angular and front-end architecture to own the design system strategy and lead the evolution of our shared component library [expanded scope and leadership]. Youll work closely with engineering leaders, product managers, and UX designers to define technical direction, enforce architectural standards, and ensure delivery of scalable, accessible, and well-tested UI solutions across multiple teams.
Youll operate in a high-trust CI/CD environmentevery commit goes to production, and theres no separate QA team. That means youll be responsible for setting expectations and ensuring quality practices are embedded in the development process. Youll drive the creation of automated test coverage strategies using Playwright for end-to-end testing and Storybook for component development and documentation.
We work with the latest technology and plan to keep doing so. Our team uses tools like GitHub Copilot to help with AI-powered coding, Figma and FigJam for design, and were always open to trying new tools that can help us create better experiences for our customers.
Our Front-End Tech Stack Includes:

  • Angular 19 in an Nx monorepo
  • Bootstrap, integrated with our custom Meridian Design System
  • Storybook for documentation and cross-team UI collaboration
  • Playwright and Jest for end-to-end and unit testing
  • CI/CD pipelines that support rapid, high-quality delivery to production

We value system thinking, performance, and platform maintainability. Youll help ensure that UI decisions support both short-term product goals and long-term architectural integrity.

What Were Looking For

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of complex Angular applications.
  • Drive the creation of a comprehensive library of reusable Angular components and services, ensuring high quality, maintainability, and extensibility.
  • Architect and manage a Git monorepo strategy for front-end projects.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a team of Angular developers.
  • Define and enforce best practices for Angular development, including coding standards, testing strategies, and performance optimization.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, and backend engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Oversee code reviews, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and quality standards.
  • Research and evaluate new technologies and tools to enhance our front-end stack.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues


Preferred Qualifications & Skill

  • Experience with Jest or other unit testing frameworks for Angular.
  • Knowledge of accessibility best practices.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for front-end deployments.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 8+ years of experience in front-end development, with at least 4 years focused on Angular.
  • Proven experience leading technical teams and projects.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Angular (versions 10+ preferred).
  • Deep understanding and hands-on experience with NgRx for state management.
  • Strong command of RxJS for reactive programming patterns.
  • Extensive experience working with Git monorepos and related tooling (e.g., Lerna, Nx).
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS/SCSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience with front-end frameworks/libraries like Bootstrap.
  • Solid understanding of responsive design principles and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.


Why Youll Love Working Here
At Assent, were more than just a companywere a community of passionate people working toward a shared goal. Heres what makes us special:
Purpose That Matters:

  • Your work will directly contribute to making supply chains more sustainable and helping businesses do better for the planet.
  • Be part of a Certified B Corporation thats proving you can balance purpose and profit.

Room to Grow:

  • Join a fast-growing company with big ambitionsand grow your career alongside us.
  • Take advantage of professional development programs, mentorship, and learning opportunities.

A Culture of Belonging:

  • Work in a diverse, inclusive environment where everyones voice is valued.
  • Join Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and participate in initiatives that matter to you.

Benefits That Care for You:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
  • Wellness programs, including mental health support and fitness initiatives.
  • Flexible work options to help you balance work and life.
  • Generous vacation and life leave days for those moments that matter most.


How to Apply
Ready to build a career that matters? Wed love to hear from you!

If you need any assistance or accommodations during the hiring process, just reach out to talent@assent.com. Were here to help!

Join Us in Building a Better Future
At Assent, were not just building a companywere building a better world. If youre passionate about sustainability, innovation, and making a difference, wed love to have you on the team.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
At Assent, we believe diverse perspectives makes us stronger. Were committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels included, respected, and empowered to succeed. No matter your background, youll find a place here where you belong.

Privacy and Transparency

Location: Vadodara

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong expertise in Windows and Linux-based application development, legacy system migration, and device driver development. The ideal candidate will lead the transition of legacy Windows XP-based embedded systems to modern platforms (Windows 11/Linux), ensuring compatibility with new hardware interfaces such as Thunderbolt and FireWire.

  • Document migration strategies and maintain traceability of features.
  • Support system testing, validation, and deployment.

Required Technical Skills

Software Development

  • Experience with Windows (XP/7/10/11) and Linux application development.
  • Familiarity with reverse engineering tools (IDA Pro, Ghidra).
  • Proficient in Visual Studio, Git, and debugging tools (WinDbg, Process Explorer, Driver Verifier).

Driver & Kernel-Level Development

  • Hands-on experience with Linux device driver development.
  • System-level programming and debugging expertise.

Hardware Interfaces

  • Experience with PCIe, USB, Serial, and custom I/O buses.
  • Familiarity with FireWire (IEEE 1394) and Thunderbolt (USB-C/PCIe).
  • Ability to work with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and interpret schematics/datasheets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in industrial control systems, automation, or embedded firmware.
  • Exposure to virtualization/emulation environments.
  • Knowledge of hardware abstraction layers and low-level system integration.

About IncredMoney.com

IncredMoney.com is a fast-growing digital wealth and investment platform empowering users with smart, simplified financial tools. We are passionate about financial inclusion, investor transparency, and secure digital experiences. As we scale, security remains central to our missionand thats where you come in.

We are looking for a dynamic and hands-on Senior Infosec Engineer who will be responsible for leading and implementing our information security and cyber-risk strategy. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in fintech or financial services, knowledge of regulatory frameworks (like RBI, SEBI), and the ability to build secure digital systems while enabling growth and innovation.

  • Build a security-first culture through training and awareness programs across teams.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for security with partners, auditors, and regulators.

  • Strong understanding of cloud security (AWS preferred), web/mobile application security, and data privacy.
  • Hands-on experience with firewalls, VPNs, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection tools.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks (especially RBI/SEBI guidelines for fintech).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field. Industry certifications like CISSP, CISM, CEH, or ISO 27001 LA are a strong plus.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience in fintech, wealth-tech, or BFSI domain.
  • Experience leading security in a startup or early-stage company.

We are seeking experienced Infrastructure Network Engineers to support BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance) clients. Role Overview Description


Job Title: Frontend Engineer
Mode: In Office
Working hours: Flexible
Compensation: 30 LPA to 45 LPA
Days: 5 days/week


About Lucio:
We're an AI product company that wants to transform the legal industry using generative AI. We're a rapidly growing team with a truly innovative product that is already being used at many top law firms in the country.

We're building a team of talented developers who are passionate about building products that solve real-world problems. With us, you'll have the opportunity to work on everything from fine-tuning LLMs, creating complex data processing pipelines, optimizing distributed services and more. Don't worry, you won't have to do everything, but you'll always have the option of working on something exciting and new.

We're looking to hire a talented Frontend Engineer who is passionate about building beautiful interfaces and new user experiences. You will excel at this role if you:

  • Have an eye for detail
  • Love creating and thinking of new user flows and experiences
  • Want to help build delightful products

Must-Have Skills (Essential):

  • Strong Proficiency in Core Web Technologies:
  • JavaScript (ES6+): Deep understanding of core JavaScript concepts, asynchronous programming (Promises, async/await), and modern language features.
  • CSS3: Excellent understanding of CSS fundamentals, layout techniques (Flexbox, Grid), responsive design principles, and CSS preprocessors (like Sass or Less, though Tailwind is a separate "Good to Have").
  • React: Solid experience building complex user interfaces with React, including component lifecycle, hooks, state management (even if not a preferred library initially), and routing.
  • UI Design Systems/Component Libraries: Demonstrated experience working with at least one major UI Design System/Component Library. MUI (Preferred) is a significant plus. Familiarity with AntD, Chakra UI, or Mantine is also valuable.
  • State Management: Practical experience with at least one client-side state management library. Redux Toolkit or Zustand (Preferred) indicates a good understanding of managing application state effectively.
  • Server-Side State Management/Data Fetching: Experience with a server-side state management/data fetching library like SWR, React Query (Tanstack Query) (Preferred), or RTK Query is highly desirable, showcasing knowledge of efficient data handling.
  • Form Handling and Validation:
  • Experience with form handling in React and implementing robust validation.
  • Familiarity with react-hook-form (preferred) for form management.
  • Knowledge of zod (preferred) or yup for schema definition and validation.
  • Performance Optimization: Proven ability to identify and implement performance optimizations in frontend applications. This includes techniques like code splitting, lazy loading, memoization, efficient rendering, and optimizing API calls.
  • Good Code Practices: Strong understanding of clean code principles, writing maintainable and scalable code, following coding standards, and using linting and formatting tools (e.g., ESLint, Prettier).
  • Version Control (Git): Proficient in using Git for version control, branching strategies, and collaborating with a team.
  • Understanding of Web Development Fundamentals: Knowledge of HTTP protocols, RESTful APIs, and browser developer tools.

Good to Have Skills (Beneficial):

  • Next.js or React Router (Remix): Production experience with these frameworks is a significant plus, indicating familiarity with server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and their respective feature sets.
  • Tailwind CSS: Experience with utility-first CSS frameworks like Tailwind CSS can be beneficial for rapid styling and consistency.
  • Node.js and Express.js: Basic understanding or prior experience with Node.js and Express.js for backend development can be a valuable asset for understanding the full-stack picture and potentially contributing to API integrations or basic backend tasks.
  • Build Tools: Familiarity with build tools like Webpack, Parcel, or Vite.
  • Accessibility (A11y): Awareness of and ability to implement accessible web applications (following WCAG guidelines).

We're looking for candidates with 5 to 8 years experience, either through great independent projects or working with companies. You don't necessarily need a degree in CS as long as you have the right skillset.

We're happy to offer up to 45 LPA based on experience and skills. We offer great benefits like:

title: Senior AI Security Engineer
jobDescription:
We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Security Engineer to join our security team. This role will be responsible for ensuring the security, privacy, and integrity of our AI and machine learning systems, safeguarding them against evolving threats. You will collaborate with data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and other stakeholders to establish robust security best practices throughout the lifecycle of AI/ML model development, deployment, and maintenance.

What you'll do:

  • Secure AI/ML Systems:Design, implement, and review security controls specifically tailored for AI and ML environments.
  • Threat Modeling:Conduct comprehensive threat modeling and risk assessments for AI/ML systems, identifying potential vulnerabilities unique to AI technologies.
  • Incident Response:Lead investigations into security incidents involving AI/ML models, recommend and implement improvements, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Security Architecture:Collaborate on developing secure architectures for AI solutions including data collection, data labeling, model training, deployment, and inferencing.
  • Secure Data Practices:Establish and enforce secure protocols for training data, ensuring privacy, integrity, and compliance with legal and regulatory guidelines.
  • Red Teaming & Adversarial Testing:Simulate attacks (e.g., adversarial machine learning, model theft, data poisoning) and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Automation and Tools:Build and maintain security tools for continuous monitoring, testing, and validation of AI/ML systems.
  • Awareness and Training:Drive internal awareness programs and provide training for engineering, product, and data science teams on secure AI development.
  • Compliance and Best Practice:Ensure companys AI initiatives comply with relevant industry standards and regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, NIST AI Risk Management).
  • Research and Development:Stay current with latest threats and advancements in AI security; propose innovative solutions to emerging risks.
  • AI Agent Development: Contribute to building secure and intelligent AI bots/agents, ensuring best practices are followed during design and deployment.
  • Development & Tools: Leverage Visual Studio and related development tools to support secure coding, debugging, and integration of AI systems.
  • MCP Integration: Apply Model Control Protocol (MCP) knowledge to manage, orchestrate, and securely control AI/ML models across different environments.

What you'll bring:

  • Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Data Science, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in security engineering, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML systems.
  • Deep understanding of AI/ML development lifecycle and typical vulnerabilities (model inversion, adversarial attacks, data poisoning, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks and security tools (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, IBM Adversarial Robustness Toolbox).
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python preferred; C/C++ and Java are a plus).

title: GPU Engineer
jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities


Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled GPU Infrastructure Engineer to join our team. This role focuses on the design, implementation, and management of enterprise network and cloud-based infrastructure to support evolving Azure cloud needs. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software, network, or systems engineering, along with hands-on experience in managing large-scale cloud and data center operations.



Responsibilities

  • Respond to incidents during regular on-call rotations and resolve issues efficiently to minimize downtime.
  • Design and plan scalable GPU infrastructure solutions to meet organizational capacity and performance needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement GPU infrastructure architecture that aligns with business objectives.
  • Evaluate GPU technologies and recommend the best hardware and software configurations.
  • Configure and deploy GPU servers, including installation and setup of hardware, software, and networking components.
  • Coordinate with vendors for procurement and installation of GPUs and related infrastructure.
  • Implement and manage GPU clustering setups for compute-intensive tasks.
  • Utilize monitoring tools to assess GPU performance metrics and system health.
  • Conduct benchmarking tests and analyze the results to identify performance bottlenecks.
  • Optimize workload distribution across GPU resources to ensure maximum efficiency.
  • Provide expert troubleshooting support for reporting and resolving GPU-related issues experienced by team members.
  • Maintain incident response protocols to address hardware and software failures swiftly and effectively.
  • Develop FAQs and knowledge base articles to streamline support processes for internal users.
  • Infrastructure Maintenance:
  • Schedule and perform routine maintenance, including updates to software, firmware, and drivers related to GPU systems.
  • Plan and execute capacity upgrades and expansions as needed, ensuring minimal disruption to services.
  • Conduct post-mortem analyses on significant incidents to improve overall system reliability.
  • Write scripts for automation of deployment, configuration management, and system monitoring tasks (e.g., Python, Bash).
  • Develop tools that increase productivity for engineering and data science teams using GPUs.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices for efficient and repeatable deployments.


Requirements

  • Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Technical Experience:

  • Proven expertise in software engineering, network engineering, or systems administration.
  • Hands-on experience with managing and debugging cloud backend server and networking infrastructure and services.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise network and cloud-based architectures, including experience working with Cisco and Azure.
  • Experience with cloud platforms providing GPU services (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
  • Understanding virtualization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and server orchestration tools.
  • Knowledge of network configurations and storage solutions used in GPU environments.
  • Strong understanding of GPU architectures (NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, etc.).
  • Experience with AI/ML workloads, HPC, or rendering applications.
  • Familiarity with PCIe, memory subsystems (DDR, HBM), and high-speed I/O.
  • Understanding of Azure Pipeline , Azure DevOps.
  • Demonstrated knowledge in deploying servers and network infrastructure equipment at scale.

Specialized Skills:

  • Experience working with GPU hardware or related system engineering.
  • Experience with:
  • Data center architecture and cloud infrastructure.
  • Network infrastructure design and management in hybrid environments.
  • Certifications in relevant technologies such as:
  • Cisco (e.g., CCNA /CCNP).
  • AZ900(Manadatory) , AZ104 (Optional).
  • OCI Foundations Associate (Optional)
  • ITIL or equivalent certifications (Optional).

title: Business Analyst/ Collection Analyst
jobDescription:
About Moneyview


Moneyviews mission is to provide world-class financial products to every deserving Indian having a Smartphone and help them succeed. The Moneyview App offers a full suite of personalized credit products such as instant personal loans, cards, BNPL products, and personal financial management solutions. Our proprietary data models provide a 360-degree risk assessment, enabling credit for the underserved segments.
This opening is in the Credit Risk and Analytics team. We are a market leader in the online/instant personal loan space, providing loans of up to Rs.10 Lakhs through a completely digital platform. Our unique IP assesses creditworthiness using multiple data sources and does not rely only on the bureau score, thus offering better approval rates and loan amounts. Our easy-to-use App makes the documentation process simple, providing the loan offer in less than 2 mins and disbursal within 24hrs! Our app has over 10M+ downloads and is one of the few highest-rated apps in the category with 4.5+ ratings.
Moneyview is an established organization, founded 10+ years ago and is funded by marquee investors including Tiger Global, Accel, and Ribbit Capital. We provide loans in partnership with NBFCs and Banks. Money view is also a founding member of DLAI - Digital Lenders Association of India - a widely recognized body for Fintech companies in India.
Qualification Criteria
Exp: 1+ years
Business analysts/risk analysts preferably from financial services, large banks/MNCs.
Demonstrated problem solving abilities and first principles based thinking
Ability to identify key drivers of business and create KPIs for the same
Power user of Excel, knowledge of SQL
Operational excellence with stakeholder management skills
Preferred background in collections
Hands on experience in R or Python, added advantage
Ability to work both independently and with direction to meet established deadlines and objectives

Responsibilities:
In this role you will work closely with the business leads to:

  • Describe: Identify the key metrics that should be tracked & set-up dashboards for the same
  • Diagnose: Identify problem points for collections
  • Prescribe: Coordinate with different partners to ensure smooth repayment and collections process

Your day-day will involve making data driven decisions by:

  • Performing analysis to identify late payment businesses
  • Quantifying and proposing risk/reward trade-offs of recommendations
  • Set up recurring calls to understand issues with re-payments
  • Applying knowledge of business and balanced judgment in interpretation of data
  • Performing ad hoc analysis and quickly provide results and recommendations
  • Engaging in a culture of Diversity and Inclusion

title: Big Data Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Overview: We are seeking an experienced and motivated Big Data Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Python, PySpark, SQL, Hive, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. As a Big Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining large-scale data processing systems to support our data analytics and business intelligence initiatives.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Architecture & Design: Design and implement scalable data architectures, pipelines, and workflows to handle large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
  • Big Data Processing: Develop and maintain data processing frameworks using PySpark to handle real-time and batch processing needs.
  • Database Management: Write efficient SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis. Manage and optimize Hive tables and queries.
  • Cloud Integration: Utilize AWS or Azure services (such as S3, Redshift, Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL) for data storage, processing, and analytics. Ensure data security and compliance with best practices.
  • Data Quality & Optimization: Implement data validation and quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency. Optimize data processing workflows for performance and cost-efficiency.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with data scientists, analysts, and other engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver solutions that meet business needs.
  • Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve data processing issues, ensuring minimal downtime and disruption to data workflows.
  • Documentation: Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of data pipelines, processes, and systems.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Masters degree is a plus.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience as a Big Data Engineer or in a similar role with a proven track record of working on large-scale data projects.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Proficiency in Python Coding for data manipulation and processing.
    • Strong experience with PySpark for distributed data processing.
    • Advanced SQL Coding skills for querying and managing relational databases.
    • Experience with Hive for data warehousing and querying.
    • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and their data services.

Note : This is completely Work From Office and 1 PM to 10 PM

jobDescription:
Job Description Ageing Stocks Executive

Position Title: Ageing Stocks Executive

Department: Sales Coordination / Operations (Cross-functional role)

Reports To: General Manager Operations / Sales Head

Role Purpose

To monitor, coordinate, and resolve all matters related to ageing stocks at super stockists, distributors, warehouses, and factory stores (RM, PM, and FG), ensuring minimum expiry losses, proper rotation, and timely disposal as per company policy.

Key Responsibilities

1.Stock Monitoring & Reporting

Track ageing of Raw Materials (RM), Packing Materials (PM), and Finished Goods (FG) at factory level.

Monitor ageing stocks (by batch, lot, MRP, expiry date) across super stockists, distributors, and warehouses.

Generate weekly/monthly ageing stock dashboards & reports with analysis and action points.

Flag items reaching critical ageing stage and escalate for corrective action.

2.Coordination & Execution

Factory Stores: Coordinate with RM/PM/FG storekeepers for ageing alerts, FIFO/FEFO adherence, and revalidation/rejection of expired lots.

Market: Liaise with sales teams for push schemes of near-expiry FG.

Coordinate with distributors/super stockists for returns, replacements, or liquidation schemes.

Work with logistics/operations for movement and safe disposal of expired/near-expiry goods.

3.Compliance & Documentation

Maintain proper records of expired stock disposals, returns, and write-offs (RM, PM, FG, and Market).

Coordinate with Accounts for debit/credit notes and write-off entries.

Ensure all handling complies with FSSAI guidelines, statutory norms, and company SOPs.

4.Vendor/Agency Coordination

Work with expiry-handling agencies for market buy-back and destruction.

Verify and reconcile agency reports vs. actuals.

For RM/PM vendors, coordinate for replacement or revalidation support where applicable.

5.Process Improvement

Suggest strategies to reduce ageing build-up at factory (RM/PM/FG) and at market (distributors/stockists).

Recommend promotions, rotation policies, or rework options for at-risk stock.

Assist in designing early-warning systems through ERP/Power BI dashboards for proactive expiry management.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strong knowledge of inventory management & stock rotation (FIFO/FEFO) across RM, PM, and FG.

Familiarity with food industry shelf-life management (raw material storage norms, packaging material expiry, finished goods shelf life).

Coordination & communication skills across Sales, QA, Stores, Accounts, Operations.

Analytical skills to interpret data and suggest actions.

ERP (Microsoft Dynamics, Zoho, SAP) & MS Excel/Power BI proficiency.

Qualification & Experience

Graduate in Commerce / Supply Chain / Logistics / Business Administration.

24 years of experience in inventory/expiry management in FMCG/food industry.

Prior exposure to expiry stock coordination at both factory & distribution levels is desirable.

Performance Metrics (KPIs)

% Reduction in expired RM, PM, and FG stock vs. baseline.

Timeliness & accuracy of factory + market ageing reports.

% Compliance with expiry SOPs (RM, PM, FG, distributors).

Recovery value from returns/expiry handling.

Coordination effectiveness (feedback from Sales/Operations/Accounts/QA).

jobDescription:
Job Title : LLM Trainer


Experience : 3+years


Location : Anywhere in the world


Language Expert : (Any one of the Below Language )(French,Italian,German,Spanish,Chinese,Japanese,Korean,Vietnamese,Turkish,Dutch,Swedish,Norwegian,Danish)


Role Overview:

This position is within a project with one of the foundational LLM companies. The goal is to assist these foundational LLM companies in enhancing their Large Language Models.

One way we help these companies improve their models is by providing them with high-quality proprietary data. This data serves two main purposes: first, as a basis for fine-tuning their models, and second, as an evaluation set to benchmark the performance of their models or competitor models.

For example, in the case of Agent Completion (AC) data generation, your task will be to simulate high-quality multi-turn conversations between a user and a smart assistant that utilizes function-calling tools to accomplish user goals. You will craft these dialogues by playing both the assistant and the user, while simulating tool use where necessary to guide the assistant through complex decision-making and real-world reasoning scenarios.


What does day-to-day look like:

Design multi-turn conversations that simulate real interactions between users and AI assistants using apps like calendar, email, maps, and drive.

Emulate both the user and the assistant, including the assistant's tool calls (only when corrections are needed).

Carefully select when and how the assistant uses available tools, ensuring logical flow and proper usage of function calls.

Craft dialogues that demonstrate natural language, intelligent behavior, and contextual understanding across multiple turns.

Generate examples that showcase the assistants ability to gracefully complete feasible tasks, recognize infeasible ones, and maintain engaging general chat when tools arent required.

Ensure all conversations adhere to defined formatting and quality guidelines, using an internal playbook.

Iterate on conversation examples based on feedback to continuously improve realism, clarity, and value for training purposes.

Collaborate with peers and reviewers to maintain consistency and high standards in deliverables.


Requirements:

3+ years of overall professional experience in a technical or analytical field.

Experience in any programming language or tech stack is acceptable; a strong grasp of APIs, data formats (e.g., JSON), and logical thinking is more critical than specific toolsets.

Strong general technical reasoning skills and the ability to model real-world assistant behavior using tool-based APIs.

Ability to break down complex tasks and simulate realistic dialogues that reflect user expectations and assistant limitations.

Excellent written communication skills in English, with a focus on clarity, tone, and instructional coherence.

Creativity and attention to detail in crafting realistic scenarios and responses.

Experience working with or around LLMs, virtual assistants, or function-calling frameworks is a plus.

Ability to follow detailed guidelines and formatting standards with high consistency.

Native or professional proficiency in at least one of the following 16 locales is required:

pt_BR – Portuguese (Brazil)

fr_FR – French (France)

it_IT – Italian (Italy)

de_DE – German (Germany)

es_MX – Spanish (Mexico)

zh_CN – Chinese (Simplified, China)

zh_HK – Chinese (Traditional, Hong Kong)

zh_TW – Chinese (Traditional, Taiwan)

ja_JP – Japanese (Japan)

ko_KR – Korean (South Korea)

vi_VN – Vietnamese (Vietnam)

tr_TR – Turkish (Turkey)

nl_NL – Dutch (Netherlands)

sv_SE – Swedish (Sweden)

nb_NO – Norwegian Bokml (Norway)

da_DK – Danish (Denmark)

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

Work in a fully remote environment.

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

Offer Details:

Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.

Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)

Duration of Contract: 6 Weeks
