tagsAndSkills: Data Science,Product Strategy,Product Management,Artificial Intelligence,Machine Learning,Go-to-market Strategy,GCP,Product Roadmap
jobDescription:
Were seeking an AI Product Manager to lead the development of a data intelligence platform that links, enriches, and unifies datasets from disparate sources. You will sit at the intersection of engineering, data, and business shaping product strategy and driving execution to bring scalable and high-impact data workflows to life.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can write technical specs, prototype solutions, and collaborate closely with engineers while keeping a sharp eye on product-market fit and user experience. You'll be at the forefront of a rapidly evolving field, learning and growing alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. If you're passionate about AI, driven to make an impact, and thrive in a dynamic and supportive workplace, we encourage you to join us!


The Team

Youll work alongside a lean but high-performing team of developers, QA, and data experts building a modern data platform. Our mission is to automate how data from multiple sources is linked and consumed, enabling clients to eliminate duplication, reduce manual work, and drive insight.

You’ll be the key driver of product thinking and delivery — guiding what we build, why we build it, and how we scale it.


Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle: from problem discovery and user research to release and feedback loops.
  • Define product requirements and technical specifications for data ingestion, entity resolution, and linking workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers to translate business logic into scalable technical solutions.
  • Prioritize features based on business value, customer feedback, and technical feasibility.
  • Write user stories, product briefs, and technical documentation to ensure clarity across stakeholders.
  • Understand customer datasets and workflows deeply to inform intelligent defaults and product design.
  • Partner with QA and engineering to ensure features are testable, verifiable, and performant.
  • Set and monitor success metrics for product adoption, accuracy, and speed.
  • Manage internal and external feedback loops to drive continuous improvement.
  • Stay close to the data — work with JSON payloads, inspect APIs, and evaluate prototype outputs when needed.
  • Design GTM strategy to expose the product commercially
  • Research and innovation: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in machine learning and NLP, and explore new techniques and technologies to improve the linking processes.
  • Deploy and maintain models in a production environment, monitoring their performance and ensuring their reliability.

Required Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of experience in product management, with a strong focus on Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP) for information extraction and MLOps
  • Proven experience leading end-to-end implementation of multiple Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI projects, from ideation to deployment.
  • Hands-on experience driving adoption of Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions at the enterprise level, with a focus on real-world impact and scalability.
  • Experience building or managing data-heavy products (e.g., ETL tools, analytics platforms, data enrichment APIs).
  • Prior experience in entity resolution, data linking, or metadata management.
  • Expertise in Python and related NLP libraries (e.g., spaCy, NLTK, Transformers, Hugging Face)
  • Experience with Apache Spark or other distributed computing frameworks for large-scale data processing.
  • AWS/GCP Cloud expertise, particularly in deploying and scaling ML pipelines for NLP tasks.
  • Solid understanding of the Machine Learning model lifecycle, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, specifically for information extraction models.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for ML models, including automated testing and deployment.
  • Docker & Kubernetes experience for containerization and orchestration.
  • Version control system experience with Git, GitHub, or Azure DevOps.
  • Excellent Problem-solving, Code Review and Debugging skills
  • Software craftsmanship, adherence to Agile principles and taking pride in writing good code
  • Techniques to communicate change to non-technical people

Role Overview

We are looking for a Tech Lead (Java) with strong hands-on experience in Java 11, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Oracle 19c, and OCI, to lead the development of our College Education Platform. The ideal candidate should bring both technical depth and domain understanding of academic workflows like student lifecycle management, faculty dashboards, library systems, attendance, examination, and fee management.

You will lead a team of developers and drive solutioning, design, and delivery aligned to product goals and customer-specific configurations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hands-on Development: Implement clean, scalable, and well-structured code using Java 11, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and REST APIs, particularly for student records, course registration, examination, and attendance modules.

  • Solution Engineering: Architect and deliver robust modules tailored for academic institutions using the existing Java-based framework and evolving product requirements.
  • Product Roadmap Execution: Translate product roadmap into development milestones, ensuring feature delivery aligned with academic calendars and client-specific requirements.
  • Technical Team Leadership: Mentor and manage a team of developers, conduct code reviews, and enforce quality standards.
  • Domain Collaboration: Work closely with Implementation, QA, and Support teams to align technical solutions with institutional workflows such as fee reconciliation, course offerings, and grading systems.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with product and delivery managers to refine specifications, resolve issues, and ensure successful rollouts.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Total Experience: 8–10 years in Java-based full stack development
  • Tech Leadership: Minimum 3–4 years in a Tech Lead or Senior Developer role
  • Core Technologies:
    • Java (11 & above), Spring Boot, Spring MVC, REST APIs
    • Oracle 19c with JDBC
    • JSP, JavaScript for UI forms
  • DevOps & Cloud:
    • Git, Jenkins
    • Docker Environment, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • Architecture & Security:
    • Strong understanding of microservices, secure authentication (e.g., JWT, SSO), and containerization
  • Methodologies & Tools:
    • Agile methodologies, GitLab, Release Notes Management

Preferred Attributes

  • Domain Expertise:
    • Functional knowledge of Student Information Systems (SIS), Course & Curriculum, Academic Timetabling, Attendance, Library, and Examination modules
    • Experience building modules for College Admins, Faculty, and Students
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent product releases across institutions
  • Strong communication

Key Performance Indicators

1. KPI: Project Completion Rate
Target: Complete 100% on time and within budget

2. KPI: Code Quality
Target: Achieve a code quality score of 8 out of 10

3. KPI: Bug Fix Rate
Target: Fix 100% of critical bugs within 3 days

4. KPI: Code Review Efficiency
Target: Every fortnight, review 100% of code changes within 9 hours

5. KPI: Version Control Usage
Target: Achieve 100% compliance with version control practices

6. KPI: Stakeholder Communication Efficiency
Target: Respond within 72 hours

7. KPI: Compliance with Design and Architectural Patterns
Target: Achieve 100% compliance

8. KPI: Automated Testing Coverage
Target: Achieve 100% coverage

Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated Manual Quality Analyst ready to take us to the next level! If you Manual Testing & API Testing and are looking forward to your next career move, apply now

Job Description

We are looking for a Manual Quality Analyst. This position will be full-time and Onsite Bengaluru.

What You’ll Do

  • Understand and comply with the defined and agreed Software Development Life Cycle and CMMI standards of the organization.
  • Understands various approaches used in testing such as System, Integration and Regression.
  • Able to apply appropriate test design techniques in writing test cases.
  • Creates test plan and test effort estimation for small to medium sized projects.
  • Reviews test cases and test scripts written by Junior Manual Quality Analyst. Make recommendations as necessary.
  • Writes test cases and test scripts, creates test data and requirement traceability matrix.
  • Properly executes the given test cases / test scripts, identifies the correct behavior of the system under test, replicates and reports uncovered defects.
  • Performs the activities necessary to execute tests in accordance with the test plan and test design (including setting up tests and test data).
  • Tests and certifies software defect fixes and new functionality. Executes functional, application and regression tests for software releases.
  • Writes clear and precise defect reports as required for identified software defects and functional defects based on testing results.
  •  Writes and submits Test Summary Report and/or Acceptance Test Certificate.
  • Collaborates with Senior Manual Quality Analyst in peer review of the RTM, test cases and test summary report and/or acceptance test certificate documents.
  • Reviews and analyzes test results and makes recommendations.
  • Enforces quality procedures and guidelines across the Software Development Life Cycle. Contributes to the continuous improvement of the QA procedures and guidelines.
  • Satisfy customer by providing clear testing specifications and quality product according to specified requirements.
  • Exhibits confidence in understanding the business concerns and provides sound business suggestions and recommendations accordingly.

What You'll Need

  • Obtained a Bachelor’s or College degree in either of the following - Industrial Engineering, Management Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology and/or related field.
  • At least three to four (3-4) years working experience in Quality Assurance and/or testing.
  • Must be proficient in writing test cases and test scripts.
  • Must have an experience in creating a Master Test plan.
  • Must have an in-depth understanding of Test Design Techniques, QA methodologies and Software Development Life Cycle (both Waterfall and Agile Development.
  • With substantial knowledge of QA testing tools, different test design techniques, standards and processes.
  • Exposure in business operations related to manufacturing, distribution and financial operations will be an advantage.
  • Experience in various system development environment.
  • A competitive analytical and problem solving skills and intermediate communicative competence.
  • Detail oriented and good time management skills.
  • Strong sense of commitment to the organization’s goals and values.
  • High flexibility in shifting schedule and extended working hours.
  • Readiness to travel to other sites

Physical Demands

  • Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationery most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc.
  • Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor.

Reasonable accommodation statement

If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employment selection process, please direct your inquiries to application.accommodations@cai.io or (888) 824 – 8111.

title: Senior/Lead AI Developer
jobDescription:
Job Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior/Lead AI Developer with extensive expertise in the latest Generative AI (GenAI), Agentic AI, and other cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of designing and deploying advanced AI solutions in dynamic, data-intensive environments.This role is perfect for an innovative thinker who thrives in fast-paced settings and is eager to push the boundaries of AI technology.


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced AI Development:
  • Architect, develop, and implement AI models and systems, with a strong focus on generative and agentic AI. Leverage state-of-the-art algorithms and frameworks to build scalable and high-performance AI applications.
  • Research & Innovation:
  • Stay abreast of the latest trends and breakthroughs in AI, particularly in GenAI and Agentic AI. Experiment with novel approaches and techniques to drive innovation and enhance product capabilities.
  • Collaboration & Integration:
  • Work closely with cross-functional teamsincluding data scientists, software engineers, and product managersto integrate AI solutions into existing systems. Ensure seamless data flow and optimal performance across various platforms.
  • Code Quality & Mentorship:
  • Write robust, clean, and maintainable code. Lead technical discussions, perform code reviews, and mentor junior developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.
  • Performance Optimization & Scalability:
  • Optimize AI models for efficiency and scalability. Address performance bottlenecks and continuously monitor system performance to ensure reliability and accuracy.

Required Qualifications

Experience:

  • Extensive industry experience in AI development, with a strong portfolio demonstrating proficiency in Generative AI and Agentic AI applications.
  • Technical Skills:
  • AI Frameworks & Libraries: Hands-on experience with modern AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) and familiarity with emerging Generative AI platforms.
  • Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python; exposure to Rust or C++ is a plus.
  • Data Management: Expertise in handling large-scale, data-intensive environments and designing efficient data pipelines.
  • Full Stack Development: Strong experience in frontend and backend development.
  • API Development: Proven experience in developing REST APIs for scalable applications.
  • AI Agent Development: Practical experience with LangChain, LangFlow, and similar frameworks.
  • Model Training & Finetuning: Hands-on experience in training, fine-tuning, and deploying AI/ML models.
  • Cloud Expertise: Familiarity with AWS or GCP cloud environments for deploying AI workloads.
  • Protocols: Worked with advanced protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) communication.
  • Core Competencies:
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration across diverse teams.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and best practices in software development.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degrees (Master’s/Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.
  • Experience with cloud-based AI solutions and infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Proven track record of contributing to AI research publications or patents in Generative AI or Agentic AI.
  • Knowledge of ethical AI practices, ensuring model fairness, transparency, and accountability.

  • Commitment to excellence. We are looking for people who care about doing good quality work, getting things done on time, and being productive.

  • Critical thinking & problem-solving. This role requires someone who uses a combination of logic and out-of-the-box thinking to troubleshoot customer issues.
  • Eager to learn. This role requires someone who is eager to learn new technologies and acquire new skills.

  • Lead and manage the day-to-day application support operations for the Mobile Heartbeat Banyan platform.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex incidents, outages, or performance issues.
  • Ensure rapid response and resolution of L2/L3 support tickets while maintaining SLA adherence.
  • Monitor application health and performance using appropriate monitoring and logging tools.
  • Maintain and enhance documentation, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for high-severity issues and coordinate after-hours support when needed.
  • Collaborate with vendor (Mobile Heartbeat) for issue escalation, product updates, and patch testing.
  • Drive problem management, identifying root causes and ensuring long-term fixes are in place.
  • Coordinate with project teams for release planning, upgrades, and change management.
  • Promote continuous improvement through automation, monitoring, and process refinement.
  • Provide technical support to customers over phone, web, email, and collaboration tools.
  • Document troubleshooting activities and resolutions for support issues in ticketing system.
  • Provide explanations of product functionality to customers
  • Assist customers in understanding how the product functions and how to troubleshoot and administer it.
  • Work with internal teams to ensure that system operation is properly monitored and documented
  • Monitor application and infrastructure health using Azure-native tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights).
  • Collaborate with development, DevOps, networking, and security teams to resolve technical issues.
  • Document customer environments, unique configurations and possible configuration limitations
  • Ensure that complex customer software issues are properly prioritized, reviewed, debugged and resolved
  • Rapidly become a product subject-matter expert
  • Manage priorities and allocate time appropriately
  • Assist in implementation and upgrade of Business Critical cloud Applications
  • Contribute content to the Knowledge Base, documenting known issues, troubleshooting steps, best practices, and common tasks
  • As part of on-call team, respond to and resolve critical system issues that arise on 24x7 basis.
  • Primary responsibility is to resolve customer issues, but some project work is also expected.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management).
  • Troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA): Lead the team in diagnosing and resolving application issues, performing detailed root cause analysis to prevent recurrence.
  • Coordinate with other teams: Act as a liaison between the support team and other departments, including development, infrastructure, and business teams, to facilitate issue resolution and communication.
  • Process Improvement & Strategy
  • Develop and implement best practices: Establish and refine support processes, standards, and procedures in line with ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) or other relevant frameworks.
  • Monitor and report on metrics: Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as ticket resolution times, application uptime, and team performance, and provide regular reports to management.
  • Knowledge management: Lead the creation and maintenance of a comprehensive knowledge base and documentation for troubleshooting and support procedures.
  • Contribute to projects: Work with development and release management teams to ensure smooth and effective software releases, providing insights on potential production issues

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in IT operations or application support, with 2+ years in a lead or senior-level support role.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Ability to communicate clearly and explain complex issues to audiences with varying degrees of technical expertise.
    • Ability to manage many customer issues of varying priority at once.
    • Ability to think clearly and react calmly.

TECHNICAL:

  • Intermediate-advanced familiarity with SQL-based query languages
  • Intermediate-advanced familiarity with Windows server
  • Experience deploying software in the cloud (particularly Microsoft Azure)
  • Familiarity with PowerShell a plus
  • Familiarity with Java or another equivalent programming language a plus
  • Familiarity with VOIP, CUCM and Avaya plus.
  • Familiarity with HL7, Active Directory, LDAP, and integration protocols is a plus.
  • iOS and Android mobile environments.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management.
  • understanding of HIPAA, PHI, and clinical workflows.
  • Mandatory: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900).

  • Create and execute test plans and test cases based upon functional and product design specifications and report results as per QA policies and procedures.

  • Review of requirements and design documents from a test automation point of view
  • Quickly grab Domain knowledge and Apply it in project execution.
  • Analyze, interpret, and report test results for both system integration and verification purposes.
  • Provide (pro-active) feedback to development and system design for bringing the Quality culture.
  • Define standard methodologies and train & guide engineers to maximize the value of test automation.

  • Flexible to work on manual testing and automation testing based on business priorities.

  • Relentless customer focus.
  • Quickly gains hands-on knowledge of product.

  • Strong Embedded Firmware Testing Experience.
  • Experience in Hardware debugging.
  • Experience in testing IOT devices.
  • Experience with Cloud-based IoT firmware testing
  • Experience in Automation testing by using Labview, Python or similar languages.

  • Experience with cellular protocols (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, LTE, NB-IoT, Cat-M)
  • Experience with RF testing and cellular network simulator.
  • Expertise in battery technologies, power profiling, and energy efficiency testing.
  • Work with CAN tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, PCAN, etc.) for data logging, analysis, and debugging.
  • Strong hands-on experience with CAN communication (CANoe, CANalyzer, etc.)

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins, and automation frameworks for embedded testing.

jobDescription:
Job Description: Senior .NET Developer

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior .NET Developer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in building scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise-grade applications using the Microsoft .NET technology stack. This role will involve developing robust APIs, working on cloud-native solutions, and mentoring junior developers, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

You will play a key role in designing technical solutions, improving system performance, and ensuring adherence to best practices in coding and deployment.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in software development using .NET Core and C#.
  • Backend Expertise: Strong understanding of OOP, multi-threading, and microservices architecture.
  • Web Technologies: Proficiency with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and LINQ.
  • Database Skills: Expertise in SQL Server, MySQL, or NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Cosmos DB.
  • API Development: Strong experience in designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Version Control: Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Testing: Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and automated test frameworks.

Preferred Skills

  • Cloud Certifications (a plus):
    • Microsoft Azure Developer Associate
    • AWS Certified Developer
    • Google Cloud Professional Developer
  • Familiarity with event-driven systems using message brokers like RabbitMQ or Kafka.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to frontend frameworks such as React or Angular is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

1. Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain complex applications using C#, .NET Core, and related technologies.
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
  • Optimize code for performance, scalability, and security.
  • Work with relational and NoSQL databases to handle data operations efficiently.

2. System Design & Architecture

  • Participate in architectural design discussions for new features and system enhancements.
  • Implement design patterns, clean code principles, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to ensure smooth CI/CD and deployment processes.

3. Cloud Integration

  • Design and implement cloud-based solutions using Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Leverage cloud services for hosting, scalability, and performance optimization.
  • Work on serverless functions, containerization, and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.

4. Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior and mid-level developers.
  • Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, and QA teams to deliver high-quality software.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical documentation, and sprint planning.

5. Continuous Improvement

  • Stay updated with emerging trends in .NET development, cloud technologies, and software engineering practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, and developer productivity.

Educational Background

  • Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Equivalent work experience may also be considered.

jobDescription:
Job Title : Senior Data Engineer


Job Summary


A Sr Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure to support data collection, transformation, and analysis. They work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure data is accessible, reliable, and optimized for performance. Key responsibilities include developing ETL processes, managing data warehouses and lakes, ensuring data quality, and implementing best practices for data governance and security.


  • Overall having experience between 6 to 10 years of experience in IT and minimum 3+ years experience in cloud.
  • Hands-on in Architecture, Design, Delivery of all aspects of Data Engineering area.
  • Hands-on experience in implementing data engineering projects.
  • Strong knowledge in Azure Data Bricks / Pyspark / Azure Data factory.
  • Strong knowledge and experience on SQL Statements and Queries
  • Experience in delivering complex ETL projects.
  • Extensive database experience with a good knowledge of Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing Concepts.
  • Hands-on coding experience in various Azure Services
  • Should have knowledge of Store Procedures, Functions, queries.
  • Strong working experience in ingesting data from various data sources and data types
  • Should have development, testing and deployment knowledge, best practices and coding standards.
  • Should have strong knowledge on performance optimization in ADF, ADB, SQL.
  • Should have strong knowledge of Data Warehouse, SQL, Data Modelling
  • Knowledge of Medallion architecture and metadata driven architecture is a must.
  • Knowledge on DevOps, Jira and Confluence is added advantage.
  • Should be comfortable working with Team and as IC.

title: Senior .NET Developer-Noida/Chandigarh
jobDescription:
Senior .NET Developer
Location: Noida/Chandigarh
Experience Required: 4-8 Years
Compensation: Up to 20-26 LPA CTC


We are looking for a passionate and experienced .NET Developer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in C#, .NET Core, backend and frontend development, and modern architectural practices such as Microservices, Clean Architecture, and Event-Driven Systems. You will work on scalable, high-performance applications in a distributed environment while following DevOps and Agile practices.

(Mandatory skills : .net, Angular , Python , Github , AI , Copilot )


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using .NET Core, Razor, and Blazor.
  • Build and secure RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and gRPC services, including API versioning and middleware management.
  • Implement and maintain Microservices using DDD, CQRS, and Event-Driven Architecture.
  • Use Dependency Injection patterns and manage IoC containers (built-in and third-party like Autofac).
  • Develop modular, reusable UI components using MVC, Razor Pages, and Blazor Server/Client.
  • Manage application state using ViewModel, Distributed Cache, MediatR, and CQRS.
  • Apply robust validation using FluentValidation, Data Annotations, and custom pipelines.
  • Enable real-time communication via SignalR with Redis-backed scalability.
  • Work with SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases for high-performance data handling.
  • Optimize application performance using caching, lazy loading, async/await, Span, and memory profiling.
  • Write unit, integration, and functional tests; participate in test-driven development using xUnit/MSUnit/NUnit.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Docker, and YAML configurations.
  • Implement secure authentication and authorization practices using OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and IdentityServer.
  • Collaborate in an Agile team with peer reviews, sprint planning, and mentoring responsibilities.

Required Technical Skills

Core Language & Backend Development

  • Proficient in C#, OOP, async/await, LINQ, generics, delegates, and expression trees.
  • Strong understanding of REST, GraphQL, gRPC, status codes, HATEOAS, and Postman.

Frontend & UI

  • Expertise in Razor Pages, Blazor Server/Client, JS interop, MVC Views, and modular UI design.
  • Skilled in modern styling with Bootstrap, CSS, SASS, Tailwind, and responsive design.

Architecture & Patterns

  • Strong grasp of Clean Architecture, CQRS, DDD, Event Sourcing, UoW, Strategic Design, and SAGA.
  • Implement REST/gRPC-based communication, message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ), and asynchronous processing. Utilize protocol buffers, custom middleware, and centralized logging in microservice environments.
    • Comfortable with service versioning, exception handling, middlewar pipelines, and routing.

State Management & Routing

  • Experience with MediatR, Distributed Caching, Session/TempData, and advanced routing.

Testing & Tooling

  • Hands-on with unit testing, mocking, integration testing, TDD, and test parallelism.
  • Familiar with Visual Studio/MSBuild, GitHub Actions, Docker Pipelines, and Azure DevOps.

Database

  • Strong knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Entity Framework Core, query optimization, and indexing.
  • Exposure to MongoDB, Cosmos DB, aggregation pipelines, and distributed setups.

DevOps & Collaboration

  • Proficient in Git workflows (Git Flow, feature branching), Swagger/OpenAPI, docs-as-code, and version control.
  • Security-first mindset with OAuth2, Role-based Access, Policy-based Authorization, and IdentityServer.
  • Experience in internationalization (i18n) and accessibility (a11y).

Soft Skills & Attributes

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork capabilities.
  • Passion for mentoring, learning, and ownership of deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Certification in Microsoft technologies or Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) is a plus

jobDescription:
Role: Financial Systems and Reporting Analyst

Location: 100% Remote 

Shift Discussed - 6:30 Pm-3:30 Am


Description

The Financial Systems and Reporting Analyst is responsible for managing and optimizing the organizations financial processes within Workday Adaptive and optionally NetSuite. This role collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, leveraging expertise in accounting principles and system functionalities to streamline workflows and support finance strategic initiatives.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Ensure financial data accuracy in Workday Adaptive by mapping new accounts timely, reviewing integration logs, and addressing/clearing issues with NetSuite (if applicable).
  • Maintain and update reporting structures, elements, and currencies in Workday Adaptive and NetSuite (optional).
  • Assist with monthly financial statement reporting by subsidiary, consolidations, and review of monthly results.
  • Prepare and maintain supporting schedules and calculations related to monthly and annual financial statements.
  • Analyze financial data to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.
  • Support financial reporting requirements, including audits, external bank reporting, and compliance reporting.
  • Review and manage incoming project requests and initiatives for potential impacts to NetSuite.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities in Workday Adaptive and NetSuite (optional) for process improvements and automation.
  • Propose and implement enhancements to streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and reduce manual efforts.
  • Maintain documentation of system processes and procedures. Develop training materials, user guides, and knowledge transfer documentation.
  • Utilize Workday Adaptive and NetSuite (optional) reporting tools to generate KPIs, dashboards, and ad-hoc analyses.
  • Extract and analyze data to highlight trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement.
  • Stay updated on Workday Adaptive enhancements, NetSuite updates (if applicable), ERP best practices, and emerging cloud technology trends.

Education and Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in accounting or finance roles, with a focus on ERP systems and financial reporting for multi-currency, multi-location subsidiaries.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or Finance.
  • Strong understanding of US GAAP, accounting principles, and financial reporting requirements; knowledge of IFRS is a plus.
  • Proficiency in Workday Adaptive (mandatory) with strong knowledge of accounting/reporting modules, elements, integrations, and functionalities.
  • Experience with NetSuite (optional).
  • Prior experience with Office Connect and Solution 7 preferred.
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, macros, etc.).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to troubleshoot issues, analyze data, and propose solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
  • Highly detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and data integrity.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CPA, CMA, ERP system certifications) are a plus.

title: Responsible Ai
jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop AI governance framework incorporating AI governance organization structure, policies, procedures and corresponding roles and responsibilities.
  • Perform periodic assessments to evaluate current AI governance posture of the organization based on leading practices (such as ISO 42001:2023, NIST AI RMF, etc.) and identify improvements for policy, procedures, roles and responsibilities etc.
  • Perform gap assessment to review current state of AI based solution to evaluate controls implemented for AI risk management including considerations for security and privacy aspects.

Preferred candidate profile


  • Perform design review for AI based solutions to ascertain adequacy of mechanism defined for managing ethical AI usage including evaluation of design aspects for addressing principles such as fairness, transparency, accountability, and privacy.
  • Perform threat modelling to identify security-related weaknesses (flaws) in code during the AI development phase and related lifecycle activities to evaluate input integrity, prompt validation, output management, ethics validation, plugin security and codebase control based on leading standards such as OWASP, MITRE ATLAS, etc.
  • Identify the external and internal dependencies of AI governance processes as well as required technologies to analyze the overall maturity of organizations AI risk management strategy.
  • Perform the AI governance risk assessment to identify the AI related design, performance, and algorithmic threats and prepare a corresponding risk treatment plan.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure that AI risk management strategies are in place across the entire organization.
  • Establish AI Governance and Ethics Management Steering Committee for periodic monitoring and tracking of all aspects of AI governance establishment and identification and progress on defined goals, objectives, and initiatives.
  • Prepare content for AI Risk and Governance Management related trainings for user awareness.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in AI/ML technologies, MLOps, LLMOps, AI Frameworks or related roles.
  • Strong understanding of Generative AI, familiarity with NLP tools and techniques, AI Governance standards and best practices (e.g., NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP Top 10 for LLM, ENISA, HITRUST, ISO/IEC 23894, ISO 42001).
  • Professional certifications such as ISO 42001 Lead Auditor, ISO 42001 Lead Implementor, CISA or equivalent preferred.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and managing AI solutions, AI governance processes, including Risk assessment, Responsible AI Impact Analysis, Model Security Testing etc.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills for effectively conveying complex AI concepts, strategies and governance initiatives to key stakeholders, enabling decision-making.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex AI governance issues and develop practical solutions.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

jobDescription:
Greetings from V2Soft,


We have immediate opening for Node.JS Fullstack developer.


Role : Node.JS Fullstack developer.

Location : Bangalore

Mode : Work from office.

Eperience : 5 - 10 Years

Skills - Node.JS, Express.JS, Typescript, AWS, NoSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Microservice Architecture.


Role & responsibilities :


About the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Node.js Developer with strong front-end experience in React.js to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have end-to-end application development expertise, the ability to lead and mentor a team, and a passion for writing clean, efficient, and scalable code. This role also involves driving best practices, improving code quality, and collaborating across teams to deliver robust digital solutions.
Key Responsibilities

  • Full Stack Development : Design, develop, and maintain scalable back-end services using Node.js and modern front-end applications using React.js.
  • End-to-End Delivery : Lead the design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance of web applications.
  • Technical Leadership : Guide, mentor, and support a team of developers, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation.
  • Code Quality & Optimization : Ensure best practices in coding, code reviews, testing, and performance tuning.
  • Architecture & Design : Contribute to system architecture decisions and ensure solutions are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business goals.
  • Best Practices & Standards : Introduce modern development practices, frameworks, and tools to improve productivity and efficiency.
  • Collaboration : Work closely with product managers, designers, QA, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions on time.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong expertise in Node.js (Express.js, Nest.js, or similar frameworks).
  • Solid front-end development experience with React.js, Redux, and related libraries.
  • Strong understanding of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and modern web technologies.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
  • Proficiency in working with databases (SQL and NoSQL such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, etc.).
  • Proven ability to lead and mentor development teams.
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and performance optimization skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with scalable distributed systems and event-driven architecture.
  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and infrastructure as code (IaC).
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Prior experience in leading technical projects and cross-functional collaboration.

Soft Skills

  • Strong leadership and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Passion for continuous learning and staying updated with emerging technologies.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Interested candidates can send your resume to : kkumarpn@v2soft.com


Regards

Kiran.

title: Golang Developer - B2C SaaS
jobDescription:
We need a Golang expert who lives and breathes microservices architecture. You'll join a team of 6 exceptional Go engineers building video processing pipelines, real-time analytics, and social media API integrations that serve 100,000+ creators. This is 80% hands-on coding writing efficient, concurrent Go code that scales.


We're a profitable, AI-first SaaS startup building social media automation tools. Our platform processes millions of videos, analyzes performance in real-time, and orchestrates publishing across multiple platforms. The technical challenge? Building efficient abstractions across our service architecture without sacrificing performance.


About Us

We're not your typical startup. We're profitable, product-led, and we've spent the last 6 months building an AI-first development culture that makes our engineers ship faster and better. No VC drama, no runway anxiety just pure execution on a product that creators actually pay for.

Our engineering team uses AI as a core development partner Claude Code, custom RAG systems, and context engineering methods that help us achieve great results the first time. We're looking for a Golang engineer who sees this as the future of development, not a threat to job security.


The Role

You'll be one of 6 senior Go engineers in a flat, collaborative team where everyone is exceptionally skilled. No hierarchy, no politics just talented engineers solving complex problems together. You'll report to our Head of Engineering who has deep Go expertise and knows when to guide versus when to get out of the way.

This is primarily a coding role (80% of your time). You'll write Go services using Gin framework, orchestrate async workflows with AWS SQS, and build data layers on PostgreSQL. The remaining 20% is collaborating on architecture decisions designing service boundaries, API contracts, and finding the right abstractions that make our system both powerful and maintainable.


What You'll Actually Do

  • Build microservices using Gin framework that handle video processing, analytics, and social media integrations
  • Design and implement gRPC services for efficient inter-service communication
  • Write concurrent Go code that processes millions of social media posts using goroutines and channels
  • Architect async workflows with AWS SQS for reliable, scalable job processing
  • Optimize PostgreSQL queries and data models for services handling real-time analytics
  • Find the right abstractions that simplify our architecture without creating performance bottlenecks
  • Collaborate with 5-6 peer engineers on service design and API contracts
  • Ship production code daily — no lengthy design phases or committee approvals
  • Profile and optimize critical paths when performance matters

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional Golang experience building software products — not DevOps tools, not data pipelines, but actual Go-based products that users interact with
  • Deep expertise with microservices architecture and service decomposition
  • Production experience with our exact stack: Gin framework, AWS SQS, PostgreSQL
  • gRPC expertise for building high-performance service communication
  • Mastery of Go's concurrency model — you know when to use channels vs mutexes vs atomic operations
  • Experience building efficient abstractions that balance flexibility with performance
  • Product company background — you've built backend systems for user-facing products, not internal tools
  • Strong PostgreSQL skills including query optimization and proper indexing strategies
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience with AWS CDK or Terraform
  • Currently based in Bangalore with ability to work from our Koramangala office — we need someone who can start within 30 days, not interstate transfers

You're The Right Person If

  • You've spent years building Go-based products where Go was the primary language, not a supporting player
  • You can design service boundaries that make sense and don't create distributed monoliths
  • You write Go code that's idiomatic, not just functional
  • You understand that efficient abstraction is about finding the sweet spot between DRY and performance
  • You enjoy working with peer engineers who are as good as (or better than) you
  • You can explain why your microservice needs its own database (or why it doesn't)
  • You optimise for the team's velocity, not just your own

What We Offer

  • Join a team of 6 exceptional Go engineers — everyone here can code, review, and architect
  • Work on real technical challenges: video processing at scale, real-time analytics, multi-platform orchestration
  • Modern tech stack with zero legacy: Gin, gRPC, AWS SQS, PostgreSQL
  • AI-first culture where you'll use cutting-edge development tools daily
  • Flat team structure — collaborate with peers, not navigate hierarchy
  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity in a profitable company
  • Daily catered lunches via Zomato Enterprise
  • Comprehensive health insurance for you and dependents
  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and certifications
  • Direct impact — your code ships to production, not into committees

In Summary

This role is for someone who has built their career on Go — not dabbled in it, not used it for scripts, but architected and delivered software services where Go was the backbone. You'll write efficient microservices, design clean service boundaries, and optimise performance where it matters.


You'll work with engineers who are all senior, all exceptional, and all focused on shipping great code. If you've spent 5+ years building Go-based products and want to solve real scaling challenges with a team that matches your expertise — let's talk.

jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities

A DevOps Engineer (DOE) is responsible for deploying and managing

Through automation, security maintenance, and troubleshooting, the DOE works with relevant stakeholders to

create maintenance-free environments.

As a DOE, you will be joining a team of enthusiastic engineers set out to deliver secure infrastructure that

directly impacts core-business outcomes. You will develop code for automated deployment and configuration, and

manage deployments by maintaining configurations and upgrading software. Environments vary from on-site

Hadoop/Spark Clusters to Amazon AWS deployments (EC2, S3, EMR, VPC, Lambda) and Google Cloud

deployments (CloudStorage, Dataproc, VPC). In this role you will frequently interact with clients to configure

software deployments which transform how they leverage technology for data intelligence.

Success in this role requires understanding the architecture and workflow of the deployments, and responding

promptly to problems. Demonstrated experience in using technological solutions and in creating exceptional

software products to solve complex business problems is key.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES IN THIS ROLE INCLUDES:

  • Infrastructure Design and Implementation: Design, deploy, and manage the AWS & Azure infrastructure

components required for our product development environment. This includes virtual networks, storage

accounts, virtual machines, and other resources.

  • Kubernetes Deployment: Set up and maintain Kubernetes clusters for deploying and scaling our applications.

Design and implement best practices for containerization, orchestration, and service discovery using

Kubernetes. Experience of auditing and logging with Kubernetes is preferred.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Develop and maintain Terraform scripts to provision and configure infrastructure

resources. Use Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles to define and manage infrastructure configurations,

ensuring consistency and reproducibility.

  • Monitoring and Alerting: Implement monitoring and logging solutions to proactively identify and address

performance issues and system failures. Set up alerts and notifications to enable timely response to incidents.

Monitor the consumption of resources and suggest optimum paths.

  • Security and Compliance: Implement security best practices and ensure compliance with relevant industry

standards and regulations. Perform security assessments, vulnerability scanning, and implement appropriate

security controls.

  • Collaboration and Documentation: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers and

operations, to understand product requirements and ensure smooth deployment and operation of applications.

Document processes, configurations, and troubleshooting guides for future reference. Lead a small team of

experts.

  • Performance Optimization: Continuously monitor system performance and identify areas for optimization. Work

with development teams to fine-tune applications and infrastructure components to improve efficiency and

scalability.

  • Stay informed about updates and changes in the product to ensure the team is well-equipped to address user

inquiries.

  • Establish and enforce quality assurance measures, ensuring that client onboarding adheres to the highest

standards.

  • Ad hoc general client support responsibilities
